source_scope.description: 2026-09-19 Ready & Set resume scope: current user resume/C2S instruction, latest 2026-09-19 Ready & Set handoff recovered from Library, live TAKY main/C2S rules, live Ready-Set PR/branch/runtime/tests, and live Netlify staging metadata inspected during this turn.

atoms.content: Resume Ready & Set under the latest TAKY governance, execute C2S, and continue implementation from the actual current state rather than reconstructing from memory.
atoms.why: The user explicitly requested governed continuation and durable conversation-to-system compilation before further implementation.

atoms.content: The live TAKY main inspected for this resume includes canonical TKY-C2S-001 and the C2S runtime activation specialization.
atoms.why: Establishes the governing canonical baseline actually used for this resumed work.

atoms.content: Before this turn's governance-only task-file commit, the verified Ready & Set implementation baseline was PR #4 on taky/exploration-journey-2026-09-18 at 58233891..., with all five inspected workflow runs successful.
atoms.why: Separates verified source/CI implementation state from later staging/device verification.
evidence: Ready First Run Parent Activation Contract: SUCCESS
Ready Foundation Assignment Bridge Contract: SUCCESS

atoms.content: Ready & Set main merge and production deployment remain blocked until explicit human approval.
atoms.why: Prevents staging/device validation work from silently becoming a production release.

atoms.content: Preserve the confirmed Ready & Set timer UI: yellow focus field, '그냥! 지금 하면 돼!', full analog clock, mission label, remaining/target time, pause, '완료했어요', BGM, and conditional REC.
atoms.why: Functional/runtime hardening must not destabilize already confirmed visual authority.

atoms.content: Focus Mode, Time Attack, old Golden assets/contracts, and rejected ready-focus-tools-v1.js are not current Ready & Set UI authority and must not be revived.
atoms.why: Prevents historical/rejected UI from being reintroduced during repair or staging work.

atoms.content: Weekly schedule should be concise, daily should be vertical, and both should use the explorer concept; however the final weekly/daily visual design is not yet locked because the preferred concept still felt visually tiring and weekly review remained unfinished.
atoms.why: Prevents implementation from falsely treating an exploratory mockup direction as approved final UI.
atoms.destination: Ready & Set weekly/daily UI design backlog

atoms.content: The current Netlify staging alias points to an upload-style deploy created on 2026-09-13; commit_ref and branch are null, so it is not evidence that the current Ready & Set safe-branch implementation is deployed.
atoms.why: Actual iPhone validation would otherwise test stale or untraceable runtime code and produce invalid release evidence.

atoms.content: The next implementation sequence is exact safe-branch staging parity, then actual iPhone/PWA validation, then only observed-gap fixes, regression validation, and finally human approval before production promotion.
atoms.why: This is the smallest high-value missing dimension between current source/CI implementation and trustworthy release readiness.

atoms.content: A deterministic exact-head staging source package path is now established for the Ready & Set safe branch. The current package was produced from head 3d96878ada0458196ff8bfc68fdcf7087ea4d1ca and includes STAGING_SOURCE_MANIFEST.json plus a verified SHA-256 for the deployable site ZIP.
atoms.why: This closes the earlier source-traceability gap and prevents stale/manual staging uploads from being mistaken for the current safe-branch tree.

atoms.content: Publishing the exact safe-branch package to the existing dedicated Netlify staging site is blocked because NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN is not configured in the Ready-Set repository. The guarded deploy workflow fails closed, and the Netlify site remains on deploy 6aa698853e51c883dd6a69c2.
atoms.why: Device validation must not begin against a stale/untraceable staging deployment, and credentials must not be exposed or persisted in source/history.

atoms.content: A staging deploy workflow must not report overall success when authorization is missing and the deploy step was skipped. Missing deploy authorization is now fail-closed so 'deploy not attempted' cannot be misread as a green deployment.
atoms.why: Preserves TAKY claim boundaries: workflow green must not imply staging parity when no deployment occurred.

atoms.content: The earlier dedicated-staging authorization block is no longer the active device-validation blocker. A Git-backed Netlify Deploy Preview was created from draft PR #5 and is source-traceable to Ready-Set commit 3d96878ada0458196ff8bfc68fdcf7087ea4d1ca.
atoms.why: PR #4 targets a non-main base and therefore did not receive Netlify preview status; a staging-only draft PR to main safely triggered the existing Git-backed Netlify Deploy Preview without merging or changing production.
evidence: netlify.toml publish='.' with no build command
rejected ready-focus-tools-v1.js absent from index and sw precache
Netlify deployed 3 functions: character-candidates, homework-analysis, time

atoms.content: Actual iPhone/PWA behavior remains unverified and is now the next active gate. Device-only behavior includes screen lock/background restoration, native share sheet, iOS recording container/MIME and acoustics, and actual BGM playback.
atoms.why: Source/CI and Git-backed preview evidence cannot substitute for real iOS runtime behavior.

atoms.content: The earlier claim that Home Screen installation had passed was false. The screenshot showed an existing production/main Ready & Set PWA icon, not a newly distinguishable staging install.
atoms.why: Staging and main used the same app name, icon and Apple web app title, so visual confirmation alone could not establish staging provenance.
evidence: user reported the launched PWA was connected to the main address
manifest at product commit used id=ready-set, name=Ready & Set, short_name=Ready & Set

atoms.content: A staging-only PWA identity overlay was deployed on Draft PR #5 so the device-validation PWA is distinguishable from production/main without changing the product runtime branch.
atoms.why: Prevent staging/main PWA identity ambiguity and avoid using the user as a debugger.
evidence: Draft PR #5 remains open, draft, unmerged

atoms.content: When the user invokes TAKY criteria, previously established project-specific criteria must be recovered without making the user repeat them. Global TAKY governance alone is insufficient.
atoms.why: Ready exploration criteria were omitted even though TAKY/C2S existed, exposing a project-context retrieval gap.
evidence: TAKY Enforcement Replay run 35407430709 SUCCESS with pass + reject-incomplete steps

atoms.content: Ready & Set now has a project-specific Drive/NotebookLM recovery pack with source map, current conversation delta, query pack and C2S review contract. NotebookLM remains REFERENCE_ONLY/EVIDENCE_ASSIST; TAKY C2S owns authority and completeness.
atoms.why: Use Drive as long-memory evidence store and NotebookLM as context reconstruction/search support while preventing NotebookLM summaries from becoming canonical by themselves.
evidence: consumer NotebookLM direct ChatGPT plugin/API not available; Drive semi-automatic boundary preserved

atoms.content: Live Ready source contradicts the recovered multi-task exploration contract: upstream task selection collapses to one selected Planner TODO and session start supplies only tasks:[label]. Today's Island/exploration-pin entry is also not first-class in runtime.
atoms.why: Green CI was insufficient because current tests did not encode the recovered exploration semantics strongly enough.
atoms.destination: Ready-Set exploration entry/selection implementation + regression suite
evidence: five current Ready workflow runs at head are SUCCESS but do not reject this collapse

atoms.source_pointer: Ready REV_07 vs live Ready runtime
atoms.content: Target-time semantics remain unresolved: REV_07 states ONE TARGET TIME / SET ONE TARGET TIME while current runtime explicitly supports targetMin/targetMs unset and declares timeOptional. Do not silently converge.
atoms.why: Choosing required or optional without recovered explicit authority would invent a product decision.
